"import cadquery as cq

# Dimensions (mm)
h_len = 80    # horizontal leg length along X
h_thk = 10    # horizontal leg thickness along Z
v_hgt = 60    # vertical leg height along Z
v_thk = 10    # vertical leg thickness along X
w = 40        # width along Y
r = 12        # inner fillet radius
hole_d = 9    # hole diameter
hole_r = hole_d / 2

# Create horizontal leg: box (0,0,0) to (h_len, w, h_thk)
horiz = cq.Workplane("XY").box(h_len, w, h_thk, centered=(False, False, False))

# Create vertical leg: box (0,0,0) to (v_thk, w, v_hgt)
vert = cq.Workplane("XY").box(v_thk, w, v_hgt, centered=(False, False, False))

# Union to form L-shape
bracket = horiz.union(vert)

# Add inner concave fillet: quarter-cylinder along Y centered at (v_thk+r, *, h_thk+r)
# Cylinder is tangent to z=h_thk (top of horizontal leg) at x=v_thk+r
# and tangent to x=v_thk (inner face of vertical leg) at z=h_thk+r
fillet = (cq.Workplane("XZ")
          .center(v_thk + r, h_thk + r)
          .circle(r)
          .extrude(w))
bracket = bracket.union(fillet)

# Horizontal leg hole: axis along Z, center (x=45, y=20), diameter 9
h_hole = (cq.Workplane("XY")
          .center(45, 20)
          .circle(hole_r)
          .extrude(h_thk))
bracket = bracket.cut(h_hole)

# Vertical leg hole: axis along X, center (y=20, z=35), diameter 9
v_hole = (cq.Workplane("YZ")
          .center(20, 35)
          .circle(hole_r)
          .extrude(v_thk))
bracket = bracket.cut(v_hole)

# Export final single solid to part.step
cq.exporters.export(bracket, "part.step")"
